title: ARI replay fixtures
description: A recorded session: the calls a host made to a `Session`, their results, and the events the session emitted, in the order they happened. `ari/host`'s replay recorder writes this format and `ari/conformance` reads it. `persistence` versions the format independently of the package and wire versions: a reader refuses a fixture whose persistence major version is higher than its own and reads any lower or equal one. Fixtures are JSON files; nothing in them is secret by design, so hosts must not record sessions that carry credentials.

FixtureDriver.description: The driver that produced the recording.

version.description: The driver's or vendor runtime's version, free-form.

identityVersion.description: The id derivation version the driver used, so replayed ids can be compared.

FixtureCallEntry.description: The host called a session member. `method` is the wire method name from methods.json, for example `session/startTurn`; `params` are the wire params without `sessionId`.

at.description: ISO-8601 time the call was made.

FixtureResultEntry.description: The call with `callId` returned. `result` is the wire result: `null` for a call that returns nothing.

FixtureErrorEntry.description: The call with `callId` failed. `callError` is set when the failure was an ARI call error; `message` is always set.

FixtureEventEntry.description: The session emitted one event. Each event `seq` appears once in a fixture.

persistence.description: The persistence version of this format. A reader refuses a higher major version than its own.

grammarVersion.description: The event grammar version the events follow.

capabilities.description: The session's capabilities when recording started.
